title: Thailand Tourist Visa from the UK | 60-Day e-Visa Help
description: Thailand tourist visa from the UK: the 60-day Tourist e-Visa for stays longer than visa-free entry allows. Documents, timing and how we apply.
h1: Thailand tourist visa (60-day e-Visa) from the UK
intro: The Thailand Tourist e-Visa lets you stay up to 60 days, twice the visa-free period for British passport holders. It is applied for online before you travel. We prepare your Thailand tourist visa application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: When you need a Thailand tourist visa
sections.text: Since visa-free stays were cut to 30 days in September 2026, the 60-day Tourist e-Visa is the easiest way to enjoy a longer holiday. It can usually be extended by a further 30 days in Thailand. Holders of passports that aren't visa-exempt need a tourist visa for any holiday.

sections.heading: Applying for the Thailand tourist e-Visa
sections.text: Applications from the UK are made online through Thailand's official e-Visa system. You'll need recent bank statements (usually no older than 30 days), your flight and accommodation bookings, and a passport photo. Allow at least two to four weeks before you travel.

sections.heading: Thailand tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.q: How long does a Thailand tourist e-Visa take?
faqs.a: Allow two to four weeks. Apply well before you travel.

faqs.q: Do I still need the Digital Arrival Card with a visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Every traveller must complete the TDAC, whatever their visa.

faqs.q: How long does a Thailand tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my Thailand tourist visa application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your Thailand tourist visa application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
